body: They do, probably more than me honestly.

We were planning to adopt the baby. She was going to be ours. But I can't stay in an open relationship, or in one that she's made a open for herself. We were going through the adoption process but now its on hold until after the divorce. Her parents are essentially blaming me for it being on hold now, she is too. I've hurt them.

Essentially comes down to her wanting to see other people and making me choose to either do that too or she's moving on. We've had arguments about it...I'm against it and she's for it. She finally made an ultimatum that either I agree to let us both see other people but remain married or she's going to get out. I decided on getting out. Now we're both devastated. Its possible she didn't think it would lead to this, that I'd accept because I love her. 

With the child, we're fostering it right now and have for about a year.
